opus.problem: Known stories first: the separation of the sheep from the goats in Matthew 25 is one of the stories goats are best known for, and it is missing. Jacob wearing goatskins to deceive Isaac in Genesis 27 is also missing. Instead, two clues (6 and 7) go to small goat-hair details. The tabernacle curtain detail is the weakest and should give way to the sheep-and-goats judgment.
